roles.drugs: Chronic sinusitis with polyps: short systemic glucocorticoid course (1–3 wk), then doxycycline (3 wk)
PCN allergy, adults: a respiratory fluoroquinolone (levofloxacin, moxifloxacin). Children: levofloxacin
PCN allergy, children: clindamycin + cefixime or cefpodoxime
Topical decongestant (phenylephrine, oxymetazoline), ≤5 days or 3 days on/3 off
Glucocorticoid nasal sprays: take ≥15 days to work, limited benefit; continued in chronic sinusitis flares
